tools.name: image_info
tools.description: Call this tool to inspect an image: format, pixel dimensions, megapixels, file size in bytes, and whether it carries an alpha channel. Read-only, never modifies the file. Free tier: unlimited, any size.

tools.name: image_resize
tools.description: Call this tool to write a resized copy. fit inside keeps aspect; cover fills and crops; exact stretches. One of width/height alone keeps aspect. Input untouched. Free: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_convert
tools.description: Call this tool to re-encode an image as PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF or TIFF. quality is JPEG-only. Transparency converted to JPEG flattens onto white; the answer says so. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_compress
tools.description: Call this tool to re-encode an image smaller and report byte counts before/after. quality (default 80) applies to JPEG; for PNG only max_width shrinks it, and the answer names which one worked. Free: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_crop
tools.description: Call this tool to cut a rectangle out of an image. x, y are the top-left corner in pixels from the image's top-left. A rectangle past an edge is refused with the image's real size, not clamped. Free: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_thumbnails
tools.description: Call this tool to write one thumbnail per input into out_dir as <name>-thumb.<ext>, fit inside size by size, aspect kept. Paths are reserved before writing, so a collision leaves nothing half-done. Free: 5/call, 4 MP.

tools.name: image_watermark
tools.description: Not available on this hosted endpoint: the watermark is drawn with bitmap font files loaded from a filesystem, which this endpoint does not have. Watermark on a local install instead - download image.mcpb from https://github.com/theluckystrike/mcp-servers/releases/latest and open it in Claude Deskto

tools.name: image_strip_metadata
tools.description: Call this tool to write a copy carrying pixels and nothing else: it decodes and re-encodes from raw pixels, so EXIF, GPS, camera, capture time, XMP and colour-profile data are dropped. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_batch_resize
tools.description: Call this tool to resize every image into out_dir, keeping aspect ratio, named <name>-<W>x<H>.<ext>. One of width/height lets the other follow; with both, each fits inside the box. Free: 5 files/call, up to 4 MP.

tools.name: image_dominant_colors
tools.description: Call this tool to read the colours covering most of an image, as hex codes with each one's pixel share. Sampled from a 200 px copy, so cost is fixed. Read-only. Free gives the top 3; Pro up to 16.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this endpoint's licence state for your token as JSON: the product, the tier free or pro, why it is not Pro, and the checkout URL. Call it to explain a free-tier refusal. No arguments, nothing changes.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Turn Pro on for this hosted connection using a key from checkout, keeping the data already stored under your current token. Pass key as MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>. A wrong or expired key changes nothing.

tools.name: image_upload
tools.description: Send an image to this hosted endpoint. There is no filesystem here, so instead of a path you upload the file once with image_upload and then pass its name as `path` (or inside `paths`) to image_info, image_resize, image_convert, image_compress, image_crop, image_thumbnails, image_batch_resize and im

tools.name: image_files
tools.description: List the images stored for your token: what you uploaded, and what this server has written, with their sizes.

tools.name: image_delete_upload
tools.description: Delete one image stored for your token, uploaded or generated.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "image_upload" is 1144 chars, far longer than this server's median (207). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "image" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: image_upload · Private data: image_info, image_watermark, image_batch_resize, license_status, license_activate, image_upload, image_files, image_delete_upload · Public sink: image_watermark, image_dominant_colors, image_upload, image_delete_upload · Destructive: image_info, image_upload, image_delete_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: image_upload · Private data: image_info, image_watermark, image_batch_resize, license_status, license_activate, image_upload, image_files, image_delete_upload · Public sink: image_watermark, image_dominant_colors, image_upload, image_delete_upload · Destructive: image_info, image_upload, image_delete_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
